events.title: VOID PROFIT Hotfix #1
events.summary: A few more fixes from the demo feedback, plus some pricing tweaks. Startup and settings fixes, safer saving and improved Steam Cloud support.Travel resumes properly after patrol inspections once outstanding decisions are resolved.Clearer rent payments and receipts, with early payment available shortly before rent is due at the Aetrocor Representative Service. Pricing tweaks for repairs, fuel, cargo handling and market information.Market feeds update more often and price estimates are more useful

events.title: VOID PROFIT Devlog #12: Two weeks to release, and after that
events.summary: Hello, Two weeks until VOID PROFIT releases on November 2. Getting close. I've also been putting together some plans for what comes afterward. Everything below is for after 1.0.0, starting with Jobs and world events. Then, a while later, a bigger update around attacking ships and mining moons. Current gameplay: planning a route. events.title: VOID PROFIT Devlog #11: More life
events.summary: Hello,The latest VOID PROFIT update is the one I called "More life". Space in front of your ship was looking a bit empty, so I've been putting other ships in it.Outside your cameraFreighters, shuttles and the occasional military traffic now pass through the cockpit view. They have their own places to be, their own stuff to do. You can keep dealing with your cargo while someone else flies past the planet outside. events.title: Playtest Starting Soon
events.summary: A VOID PROFIT playtest will be starting soon. The start of July is the test start range. This is a pre-demo playtest that will be indicative of the whole experience of playing the game. A demo will be released in the weeks following the playtest for people who will be more interested in playing a section of the game without the requirement of giving feedback. events.title: VOID PROFIT Devlog #9 - Keep the manifest clean
events.summary: VOID PROFIT Devlog #9: Keep the manifest cleanA new game system has been addedThe manifest systemA new game system that expands on the current gameplay has been added. It's the manifest system. You now have to keep a manifest for your cargo. BUT DON'T WORRY! It gets automatically populated when you buy or sell cargo. You just need to "File" and/or change it. events.summary: VOID PROFIT Devlog #8: Authored DialogueA massive overhaul of the dialogue system has been implementedA more natural dialogue systemBefore this change dialogue was constructed from different lines based on world, player and market states. As the variety of states changed, this dialogue was starting to feel extremely unnatural. events.title: VOID PROFIT Devlog #7: Deepening Gameplay
events.summary: VOID PROFIT Devlog #7: Deepening GameplayMade some changes that should deepen gameplay and improve emergent gameplay possibilities.Pirate GuildThe Pirate Guild was just a major/core faction. They behaved like everyone else and, since they don't have any cargo they consider illegal, were just a nuisance. Now they act completely differently.
